svg.metadata: {"id": "s059", "name": "校园菜园", "cat": "艺术与劳动", "tags": ["劳动", "种植", "科学", "自然观察"], "desc": "阳光下的校园菜园：教学楼与白色栅栏前三块木框菜畦，番茄架、青菜、胡萝卜、茄子与玉米，向日葵、喷壶、小推车和翩翩蝴蝶。", "stand": {"ground_y": 910, "x": [560, 1360]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.2, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "building", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "trees", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.35, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "ground", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "fence", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "sunflowers", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.5, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "bed_left", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "bed_right", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "foreground", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "butterflies", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "bob", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#9ED8F5", "sky2": "#F1FAF7", "bld": "#FBEBD2", "bld2": "#F2D7B3", "roof": "#E2715E", "win": "#BFE3F5", "win2": "#FFFFFF", "fence": "#FFFFFF", "fence2": "#E1E6EA", "grass1": "#A6D68A", "grass2": "#86C46E", "soil": "#9C6B48", "soil2": "#7E5236", "bed": "#C9925A", "bed2": "#A8723F", "leaf": "#5BAA5E", "leaf2": "#8ED07C", "leaf3": "#3F8C4E", "tomato": "#EF5A45", "carrot": "#F2973E", "corn": "#F7D048", "eggplant": "#7B4A9C", "sun": "#FFD36E", "sunf": "#F7C13E", "sunf2": "#7A4E2C", "can": "#5FB7D6", "can2": "#3E97BB", "barrow": "#F2836B", "barrow2": "#D0644E", "path": "#EAD8B4", "fly1": "#F7A6C0", "fly2": "#FFD36E", "stake": "#C9A27A"}}
